notes.title: American Arcadia - Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
As we mentioned in our last blog, we've got a small update to fix some bugs and improve American Arcadia that were discovered after the game launched. Thanks to everyone for your support and for helping us improve the experience of the game!

[h1]American Arcadia - Hotfix #1 Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted audio option to prevent high volume in loading videos
[*]Fixed missing subtitles in Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese, and Korean
[*]Fixed missing or attenuated voices in very few sequences
[*]Adjusted the range for interacting with some objects
[*]Fixed and adjusted the location of some checkpoints
[*]Fixed an infrequent block when [spoiler]using the CCTV lamp device for catching the robot[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed an infrequent block due to not be able to interact with [spoiler]ZW's phone in cafeteria.[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed an infrequent crash after [spoiler]exiting during Steganography encryption puzzle[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed an infrequent crash in [spoiler]Javert chase in Sewers[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed an infrequent block in [spoiler]button previously to Braintrip Spectrex[/spoiler]
[*]Added feature of fullscreen
[*]Minor adjustments of timing and acting in some sequences
[*]Minor additional bug fixes
[*]Angela can now boop the cat
[/list]
